title: Synchronous OS command execution in javascript — review required
description: execSync runs a command through the system shell and blocks until it finishes. Any request text concatenated into the command string is interpreted as shell syntax, so metacharacters become command separators. The rule flags the call; argument provenance is a review decision.
remediation: Replace execSync with execFile or spawn with an argument array and shell disabled, and validate every argument against an allowlist.
limitation: Lexical: matches execSync calls; wrapper functions that call it are out of scope.

tests.line: # audit: const out = execSync("ls " + userInput); present
